text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] INC-2026-042: sudden RPM spike on mistral-family -> noisy neighbors on GPUs, increased 5xx downstream. paging eng-oncall.

sara: paging ack, I'm taking triage. seeing elevated backend latency as well. grabbing dashboards.

matt: I can help. which exact model tags? prometheus shows mistral-8k and a smaller bump on hera-7b.

danielle: confirmed from traces: mistral-family requests have larger seq len distribution causing KV pressure. customer impact: a handful of high-throughput tenants seeing timeouts (~3 tenants flagged).

sara: plan: 1) rapid per-model RPM reduce for mistral-family 2) disable funcall on hera-7b for now 3) enable fallback routing to mistral-lite where sensible. will execute and monitor.

lia: +1. recommend conservative numbers: mistral-family rpm -> 40 (was 120), mistral-lite route rpm -> 80 for canary traffic. also set temp tenant carveouts for the 3 affected customers.

matt: ready to run commands. Sara, do you want me to run the control-plane change?

sara: please. run the API change and post the curl. I'll watch metrics and roll back if errors increase.

matt: executing now:```bash
# set RPM for a model family
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/quotas 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model_family":"mistral-family","rpm":40}'
```

matt: response 200, change queued to control-plane, propagation to edge ~30s.

sara: seeing initial drop in CPU and 5xx within 45s. latency p50/p90 improving. good so far.

danielle: I'm toggling funcall off for hera-7b to reduce external IO. running:```json
{"model":"hera-7b","feature_flags":{"funcall":false}}
```

danielle: funcall toggle applied, monitoring.

lia: notified support to message the 3 impacted tenants with a brief heads-up: "experiencing degraded throughput, we've applied temporary quota changes; will update when stable."

sara: customer impact: reduced throughput but improved success rate. asking product for prioritization of customers needing capacity.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder -> sara is oncall until 08:00 UTC, matt will be backup until 08:30 UTC. leaving notes in the incident doc.

matt: next steps: keep throttled rpm for 30m, collect 15m/30m windows, consider gradual ramp if stable. create post-incident task to analyze KV cache pressure and rewrite batching heuristics.

lia: created ticket RED-2471: "Investigate mistral-family KV cache pressure & adaptive batching" and assigned to eng-runtime.

sara: closing the live mitigation loop here. if we see another spike we will escalate to capacity and consider model-level softcap. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 mitigations recorded. Follow-up channel: eng-runtime for root-cause and postmortem.
